fosterEtAl2001SessionRpeTrainingMonitori: Foster et al. (2001): session-RPE training monitoring
actualRecordedSleepMinutes60IndependentO: Actual recorded sleep minutes / 60; independent of time in bed. Assigned to the waking date.
reportedMinutesNeededToFallAsleepMissing: Reported minutes needed to fall asleep. Missing is not zero.
recordedCountOfAwakeningsDeviceAndSelfRe: Recorded count of awakenings; device and self-report methods may differ.
vendorDefined0100ScoreNotAUniversalMeasu: Vendor-defined 0–100 score, not a universal measure. Compare within a consistent device/source.
projectDefined110RatingVeryPoorToExcelle: Project-defined 1–10 rating: very poor to excellent. Not a validated clinical questionnaire.
recordedHeartRateVariabilityInMillisecon: Recorded heart-rate variability in milliseconds. rMSSD and SDNN describe different statistics; filter to a consistent method and measurement source. The app does not calculate HRV from raw beats.
recordedRestingHeartRateInBeatsMinutePos: Recorded resting heart rate in beats/minute. Posture, timing, device and measurement conditions can change comparability.
recordedBreathsPerMinuteNoDiagnosticThre: Recorded breaths per minute. No diagnostic threshold is inferred.
recordedBodyTemperatureInCMeasurementSit: Recorded body temperature in °C. Measurement site and method should stay consistent.
recordedBodyMassInKgShortTermChangesAre: Recorded body mass in kg. Short-term changes are not necessarily changes in body composition.
sumOfRecordedSessionMinutes60ExplicitRes: Sum of recorded session minutes / 60. Explicit rest is zero; unrecorded training is missing.
sumOfSessionDurationInMinutesPerceivedEf: Sum of session duration in minutes × perceived effort. Arbitrary units, inspired by session-RPE research; the project-defined 1–10 effort scale is not an exact reproduction of a validated protocol. Missing any effort makes daily load unknown.
sumDurationEffortSumDurationAcrossAllRec: Sum(duration × effort) / sum(duration), across all recorded sessions. Undefined on rest/unrecorded days or when any effort is missing.
numberOfRecordedSessionsExplicitRestIsZe: Number of recorded sessions. Explicit rest is zero; unrecorded training is unknown.
numberOfSymptomsListedUnknownWhenBothThe: Number of symptoms listed. Unknown when both the list and illness rating are unrecorded. A zero count is not proof of health.
sumOfListed110SymptomSeveritiesADescript: Sum of listed 1–10 symptom severities. A descriptive, project-defined total, not a validated illness score; symptoms can overlap.
clockTimeEncodedAsSin2Minutes1440Or: Clock time encoded as sin(2π × minutes/1440) or cos(2π × minutes/1440). Select both components to represent a full daily cycle without a midnight discontinuity. Units are dimensionless, not hours.
1Trained0ExplicitRestUnrecordedIsMissing: 1 = trained, 0 = explicit rest; unrecorded is missing.
1ActivityRecordedThatDay0NotListedOn: 1 = activity recorded that day; 0 = not listed on a known training/rest day. Multiple activities can be present.
1SymptomListed0NotListedWhenSymptomIllne: 1 = symptom listed; 0 = not listed when symptom/illness information was recorded. Missing when both are unknown. Not a diagnosis.
indicatorAgainstManualSourceReferenceAcc: Indicator against manual-source reference. Accounts for a label, not a calibration between devices.
indicatorAgainstUnknownMethodReferenceIn: Indicator against unknown-method reference. Including this indicator does not make HRV methods interchangeable.
calendarDayIndicatorWithMondayAsTheRefer: Calendar-day indicator, with Monday as the reference. Derived from the journal date, not the current browser timezone.
1ThisLabelListed0ExplicitlyRecordedConte: 1 = this label listed; 0 = explicitly recorded context without this label; missing = context not recorded. User-defined context, not verified exposure.
localJournalDateYyyyMmDdSleepBelongsTo: Local journal date (YYYY-MM-DD). Sleep belongs to the date of waking.
structuredContextLabelsNullAbsentNotReco: Structured context labels: null/absent = not recorded; [] = explicitly no labels; otherwise presence indicators. User-defined, not validated exposures.
optionalSelfReportedNarrativeNotUsedByTh: Optional self-reported narrative; not used by the statistical model.
scaleDescription: {{min}}–10: {{low}} to {{high}}. Project-defined anchored self-report, not a validated clinical scale.
